title: Integrating Action Prefix Prediction and Alignment Across Modalities for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13782v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning representations from multimodal observations is difficult in reinforcement learning with limited interaction data. Multimodal Joint Predictive Representation combines multimodal latent prediction with contrastive learning across modalities, but its recursive rollout depends on earlier predictions and its pairwise alignment focuses on correspondence between modalities. We propose Improved Predictive Representation, which combines prediction from action prefixes with alignment at the observed anchor based on Contrastive Multimodal learning. At each horizon, it predicts future representations directly from the observed anchor and the corresponding sequence of actions. We evaluate two crop configurations: IPR-S with a minimum retained crop area of 10%, and IPR-H with 50%. Across five DeepMind Control Suite tasks, IPR-H achieves an average return across tasks that is 10.0% higher than the baseline with visual and depth images and 3.4

tldr: 提出改进预测表征方法，将动作前缀预测与基于观测锚点的跨模态对比对齐相结合，直接从观测锚点和动作序列预测未来表征，在DeepMind Control Suite五个任务上平均回报显著优于基线。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Improved Predictive Representation, which combines action prefix prediction with contrastive alignment at observed anchors to directly predict future representations from observed anchors and action sequences, achieving significantly higher average returns than baselines across five DeepMind Control Suite tasks.
